description: Ingest Metronome customers and their invoices via the Metronome billing API and return a pandas DataFrame (one row per invoice) for finance reporting.

outputs.description: DataFrame of invoice header fields (id, status, total, subtotal, issued_at, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, customer_id, ...) plus a nested line_items column.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

customer_ids.label: Customer IDs
customer_ids.description: Specific Metronome customer IDs to fetch invoices for. If unset, all customers are listed and invoices fetched for each.

invoice_status.label: Invoice Status
invoice_status.description: Filter invoices by status (e.g. 'DRAFT', 'FINALIZED', 'VOID'). Unset fetches all statuses.

starting_on.label: Starting On
starting_on.description: Only include invoices starting on/after this ISO-8601 timestamp. On a partitioned run {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} (and {partition_<dimension>} for multi-partitions) are substituted.

ending_before.label: Ending Before
ending_before.description: Only include invoices ending before this ISO-8601 timestamp. On a partitioned run {partition_key}, {partition_date}, {partition_start} and {partition_end} (and {partition_<dimension>} for multi-partitions) are substituted.

customers_page_limit.description: Page size for the GET /customers listing (only used when customer_ids is unset).
customers_page_limit.label: Customers Page Limit

invoices_page_limit.description: Page size for the GET /customers/{id}/invoices listing, per customer.
invoices_page_limit.label: Invoices Page Limit

max_customers.label: Max Customers
max_customers.description: Safety cap on the number of distinct customers to fetch invoices for in a single run.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners -- team names (team:finance) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['metronome', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key of the MetronomeResource this asset depends on for authentication

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: Metronome Invoices Ingestion
